title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
🌍 Revolucionamos la energía para cambiar el mundo

En Octopus Energy, no somos una eléctrica tradicional. Somos un equipo de personas apasionadas que trabaja cada día para hacer que la energía sea 100% renovable, accesible y justa para todos.

Creemos en la tecnología y la innovación como motores del cambio. Queremos transformar la forma en que el mundo consume energía, eliminando barreras, simplificando procesos y ofreciendo un servicio más humano y transparente.

Por esto mismo, nuestro compromiso es claro: la energía limpia debe ser la norma, no la excepción. Para lograrlo, combinamos sostenibilidad con un enfoque centrado en las personas, impulsando un servicio excepcional y construyendo un equipo increíble que comparte nuestra visión.

💡 Pero nada de esto sería posible sin personas como tú. Para seguir creciendo y transformando el mercado, buscamos talento con ganas de marcar la diferencia. Si quieres formar parte de este cambio, aportar tu energía y ayudar a construir un futuro más verde.


¿Qué estamos buscando?
Buscamos un/a Product Designer (UX/UI) para unirse a nuestro equipo de Tech. Construimos las herramientas, automatizaciones y productos que hacen que Octopus funcione: lo que usan nuestros equipos cada día y lo que verán nuestros clientes. Construir rápido no basta. Lo que construimos tiene que ser fácil, claro y agradable de usar.
Vivirás dentro de Tech, codo con codo con PMs y developers, y trabajarás muy pegado/a al equipo de Diseño para que cada pantalla respire la marca Octopus. Buscamos a alguien que haga de puente: que hable el idioma tech y el de la marca, y que defienda siempre a quien está al otro lado de la pantalla.
 
🐙 Lo llamamos el ‘Efecto Octopus’
 
Trabajar en Octopus Energy significa formar parte de una compañía donde la cultura y las personas son lo más importante.
 
💜 Apostamos por la flexibilidad y la conciliación.
 🚀 Queremos que desarrolles tu potencial al máximo.
 🌱 Creemos en un modelo energético más justo y sostenible.
 
 ¡Te estamos esperando! 🚀
 
 Diseñar de principio a fin : desde entender el problema hasta la UI final. Llevar la marca al producto: junto al equipo de Diseño, aplicar y evolucionar nuestras directrices en entornos digitales, y construir y mantener un sistema de componentes para Tech. Trabajar pegado/a a Tech : prototipar rápido, hacer handoffs claros y revisar que lo construido se ajusta a las directrices de Diseño. Simplificar sin miedo : en energía todo tiende a ser complejo (facturas, tarifas, contratos). Tu trabajo es que no lo parezca. Investigar con usuarios reales : hablar con nuestros clientes, y sentarte con nuestros equipos de atención al cliente, marketing y operaciones para ver cómo trabajan, hacer entrevistas y tests de usabilidad, y llevar lo aprendido a decisiones concretas. Al menos 3 años diseñando producto digital (web, app o herramientas internas). Queremos ver en tu portfolio cómo piensas: el proceso y las decisiones, y no solo pantallas bonitas. Figma a nivel experto y experiencia construyendo o manteniendo design systems. Experiencia haciendo entrevistas y tests de usabilidad , y sabes cambiar de opinión cuando los usuarios te lo dicen. Te sientes cómodo a la hora de utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial. Sensibilidad técnica: entiendes cómo se construye lo que diseñas (HTML/CSS, componentes, estados, limitaciones) y has trabajado con design systems. No vas a programar, pero necesitamos que entiendas a los desarrolladores y que ellos te entiendan a ti. Comunicación excelente en español e inglés (somos globales, así que el bilingüismo es clave). Mentalidad "Ego-free" : en Octopus, el ego es el enemigo. Nos importa lo que funciona, no de quién fue la idea. Si un diseño no sirve, se tira a la basura y empezamos de nuevo. 💡 Es un plus si: Utilizas IA en tu workflow del día a día. Has diseñado productos SaaS, y además conoces el mercado energético español, ¡nos harías muy felices! 📍 Ubicación: Valencia. 🏢 Modalidad: Híbrida ⏳ Horario: 40h semanales - Jornada Completa. 📈 Beneficios extra: 💰 Share options de Octopus Energy. ☕ Desayuno y fruta en la oficina. 🏥 Retribución flexible (comida, transporte, guardería, seguro médico...) 🚘 Ayudas para la compra de vehículos eléctricos. 🏦 Plan de pensiones. 🎓 Formación en producto y desarrollo profesional. 🎉 Ambiente dinámico, cercano y divertido. 🍽️ Eventos: Family Dinner y muchas más experiencias en equipo. En Octopus Energy, hacemos las cosas diferentes. Creemos en un entorno laboral donde puedas ser tú mismo/a, desarrollarte profesionalmente y sentirte parte de un equipo que realmente quiere cambiar el mundo. 🏆 ¡Somos un Great Place to Work! En Glassdoor, hemos sido reconocidos como una de las 50 mejores empresas para trabajar y nuestra cultura ha sido destacada en múltiples ocasiones. 🎙️ Si quieres conocer más sobre cómo trabajamos, escucha a nuestro CEO en este podcast sobre nuestra cultura y valores.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 


Siamo alla ricerca di un UI/UX Designer che voglia contribuire a creare un’esperienza memorabile ed eccellente per i nostri clienti, trasformando la complessità del mondo dell’energia in esperienze semplici, intuitive ed empatiche, con un impatto concreto sulla vita delle persone.

 UX/UI e Usabilità: Migliorerai l'interfaccia e l'usabilità delle diverse aree della nostra piattaforma, supportando il modo in cui i clienti interagiscono con il mondo dell'energia. Product e UI Design: Tradurrai requisiti di prodotto in flussi, wireframe e interfacce su Figma, curando stati, responsive ed edge case, adattando la creatività visiva alle linee guida di Octopus Energy. Gestione del Design System: Collaborerai alla creazione e al mantenimento del Design System su Figma, curando la libreria di componenti, i pattern di interazione e la documentazione. Collaborazione e Feedback : Contribuirai alla roadmap di prodotto, condividendo bozze fin dalle prime fasi per raccogliere feedback e stimolare il confronto. Esperienza sul campo: Almeno 2 anni di esperienza professionale nella progettazione di prodotti digitali. Pragmatismo e puntualità: Sei una persona concreta e ancorata ai fatti. Sai immergerti nella complessità dei nostri processi, ma allo stesso tempo portare a termine il lavoro rispettando le scadenze. Flessibilità e aderenza al Brand: Capacità di muoversi agilmente all'interno di un Design System strutturato, integrando la propria visione con le linee guida e l'identità visiva di Octopus Energy. Padronanza di Figma: È il nostro strumento principale per la progettazione UI/UX, la prototipazione e le review visive di prodotto. Esperienza con i Design System: Solida dimestichezza nell'uso, nell'evoluzione e nella gestione di librerie di componenti scalabili. Padronanza dei processi di design: Sai esattamente quali step della ricerca o della prototipazione sono necessari e quali si possono snellire in base al tipo di progetto o al problema da risolvere. Inglese fluido Conoscenza di ASANA, Miro, Notion considerata un plus. Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza. Equity Options Scheme : in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme. Focus sul tuo benessere : ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico. Cultura : ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner. Sede: Ancarano/Ascoli Piceno Richiesta presenza in ufficio Disponibilità: immediata Ore: Tempo pieno RAL a partire da 28.000 €, commisurata all'esperienza La normativa ci chiede di indicare una fascia retributiva, e ci sembra giusto farlo. Allo stesso tempo, non amiamo la burocrazia né crediamo che il valore di una persona possa essere racchiuso in una tabella. Preferiamo usare il buonsenso: l'eventuale offerta sarà costruita sulla base delle valutazioni fatte durante il percorso di selezione, tenendo conto di esperienza, competenze, luogo di lavoro e allineamento con il ruolo e con ciò che stiamo costruendo.

title: Staff product designer
description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.



We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!




THE ROLE

To run a sustainable business, our customers need climate insights at their fingertips. That’s where great design comes in — we are building powerful software that enables the biggest companies in the world to measure their carbon footprint with ease, and drive change across their organization. Product designers at Watershed partner closely with product and engineering from vision through execution, painting the big picture and sweating the details. We’re experts in our customers goals and pain points, and drive constant iteration to get the right solution in hand to meet their needs. As designers we push each other to perfect our craft and uplevel the outcome, treasuring our weekly jams and crits. And working in sustainability, you’ll build domain expertise in one of the most critical and motivating problem spaces.



We are hiring a product designer to lead our reporting team based in London, driving our most critical platform and product investments to scale and grow our impact globally. In this role you will:

 - Lead design for our ESG reporting application, helping Watershed build a highly competitive, end-to-end reporting product and platform

 - Design and ship experiences that allow the world’s largest organizations to scale their own reporting efforts via: AI-powered multi-player report authoring, reusable metrics and answers, flexible report customization, and more

 - Drive deep discovery to uncover new product opportunities. Use customer feedback and product analytics to iterate quickly and move meaningful product and business metrics

 - Build the vision and product strategy to bring the next chapter of product to life

 - Partner closely with EPD teams to execute, and GTM to understand and build for the market

 - Leverage AI throughout your design process, as well as in the product itself to deliver great outcomes
   
   

You might be a fit if you:

 - Have 5+ years experience designing software, preferably at B2B software companies or in technical/complex problem spaces

 - Have a knack for in-the-weeds systems thinking and a love for rapid, 0-1 product building

 - Have a track record shipping powerful and intuitive product experiences that customers love

 - Are proficient in design craft fundamentals — consistently demonstrating solid design process, strong interaction craft, and an eye for polish

 - Have shipped AI products, and are proficient using AI tools to aid discovery, synthesis, and design execution

 - Are customer obsessed and excited to spend time with users and prospects

 - Are enthusiastic about product and business ownership — you are excited to go deep on climate and become an expert on the market’s paths forward

 - Want to join a startup, take responsibility for the fate of the company, and move fast

 - Prior experience in the climate space is not necessary
   
   

This position will be in person in our London office 3-4 days per week.

   





   

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.



What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.



What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: Digital Designer
description: Digital Designer  PH location / Remote first  Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. A bit about the role We are looking for a creative and collaborative Digital Designer to join our Digital Product team! In this role, your goal is simple: help us design the digital experiences that turn curious consumers into loyal subscribers. Working closely with our eCommerce Specialist, Growth Marketing, and Creative partners, you will take our brand campaigns and translate them into engaging on-site experiences. You’ll work closely with our Product Designer on the storefront, with a focus on visual craft, brand expression, and keeping the storefront looking fresh and commercially effective. We are also excited for this person to embrace AI. You'll use AI tools to speed up your day-to-day workflow—handling routine formatting and generating assets so you have more time to spend on the actual creative craft that AI can't replicate. If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in: Helping design a site takeover for a new product launch (like adding a cameo from “Clammy” as a temporary avatar during our Splash Limited Edition). Using AI tools to generate draft assets and format standard banners, saving yourself hours of manual resizing. Collaborating with Growth Marketing to iterate on landing pages, making sure the design connects the ad content smoothly to the shop experience. Partnering with the Product Designer to ensure your campaign placements fit nicely within the everyday storefront. Updating standard campaign placements (banners, hero treatments, product callouts) to keep the site looking unmistakably Who Gives A Crap. Sprinkling digital easter eggs across the site that reward curiosity (like hiding toilets across the site for a "Where's the Loo" Limited Edition campaign). Let’s talk about you You are a solid visual designer who understands that great digital design isn't just about looking good—it's about helping the customer find what they need. You have a great eye for typography and composition, and you're eager to learn how your designs impact metrics like conversion. Here’s what we're hoping you'll bring to the table: Visual Craft: You have a strong portfolio of digital work. You know how to take a campaign brief and apply it to digital surfaces while keeping the brand feeling consistent and high-quality. Curiosity around AI: You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to speed up your production work, but you know that the final brand finish and quality control always stay with you. Commercial Interest: You want to know why a design works. You're curious about how campaigns perform on site and are open to using customer insights to tweak your designs. A Collaborative Mindset: You are a great team player. You listen well, adapt your communication style depending on who you are working with (marketing, engineering, etc.), and take constructive feedback in stride. Time Management: You know how to juggle multiple tasks. Campaign work moves fast, so you are good at prioritizing your time, keeping the team updated on your progress, and flagging when you need help. You give a crap Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too! Why should you work with us? First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that. Have you made it this far? If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

title: IT Service Design Lead (12 Month Contract)
description: Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! Funny name, serious business We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2024, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good. We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. A bit about the role We are looking for a highly organised IT Service Design Lead to join our IT team on a 12 month fixed term contract. In this role, you will be the vital bridge that connects technical IT and Security changes to the actual humans who use them. You won’t be expected to configure systems, write code, or own technical implementations. Instead, you'll bring structure, coordination, and momentum to how IT services are designed, introduced, and adopted across the business. Coaching our Change & Communications Coordinator through regular 1:1s, helping them own defined workstreams and manage peer-level stakeholder relationships. Let’s talk about you You’re a master of structure, curiosity, and stakeholder management You don’t need deep technical or security expertise to be successful here, but you do need to be comfortable leaning into ambiguity, getting up to speed quickly, and bringing order to complex rollouts. title: Performance Designer & Video Editor (a)
description:
Role Overview:
The Performance Designer & Video Editor plays a crucial role in driving growth and conversion across all paid social touchpoints, primarily focusing on channels such as Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Combining strong creative instinct with execution, this role turns strategic insights into high-converting statics, dynamic motion graphics, and engaging UGC edits that capture attention and compel action.
This position is designed for an AI-first creator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced performance marketing environment. Rather than viewing AI as an optional add-on, the ideal candidate uses generative tools as a primary engine to multiply output speed, build scalable design systems, accelerate creative testing, and reliably produce high-performing ad variations at scale.

Job requirements

Essential

 - Performance Design & Video Portfolio: Proven experience in digital graphic design and short-form video editing, backed by a strong portfolio of live paid social ads (statics, motion graphics, and UGC).

 - Mobile-First Ad Mechanics: Deep understanding of paid social frameworks, including scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced retention pacing, native visual triggers, dynamic captions, and platform safe zones.

 - Tool Stack Mastery: Design capability in Figma or Canva, paired with proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or CapCut Pro).

 - Generative AI Workflows: Practical experience using AI production tools (such as ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Runway, HeyGen, or Captions) to accelerate ideation and editing.

 - High-Volume UGC Iteration: Hands-on experience editing raw creator footage into polished ad concepts and rapidly building multiple hook/layout variations from a single brief.

 - Performance Collaboration: Agile, collaborative mindset - able to take data-driven feedback from Creative Strategists and Performance Marketers to quickly iterate on creatives and generate variations.

Desirable

 - Performance Marketing Context: Experience working directly within or alongside growth/performance marketing teams or agency ad operations.

 - Data Fluency: Practical understanding of key performance metrics (such as Click-Through Rate, Hook Rate, Hold Rate) and how visual decisions directly influence ad outcomes.

 - D2C or Regulated Space: Previous experience with Direct-to-Consumer (D2C), health tech, or healthcare brands.

Education & Qualifications:

 - Degree in Graphic Design, Motion Design, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience demonstrating strong creative output.


Job responsibilities

Design & Asset Production

 - Direct-Response Statics: Design high-converting, mobile-first static ad graphics and layout variations.

 - Motion Design: Create dynamic motion graphics, kinetic typography, 2D animations, and native UI/product demos.

 - Short-Form Video & UGC: Cut raw creator footage into engaging, fast-paced videos with native captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.

 - Platform Optimization: Ensure all deliverables strictly adhere to platform safe zones, mobile aspect ratios, and channel best practices.

Rapid Creative Iteration

 - Hook & Angle Testing: Partner closely with the Creative Strategist to brainstorm and execute new visual hooks, copy angles, and graphic variations to combat creative fatigue and scale campaign spend.

 - Data-Driven Edits: Rapidly spin out variations of winning concepts based on performance data.

AI-Powered Workflows & Systems

 - Generative Production: Actively integrate generative AI tools (e.g., for voiceover synthesis, script-to-video editing, image generation, and automated captioning) to multiply weekly creative output.

 - AI Asset Management: Build and maintain a library of assets (AI-tagged / organized), motion presets, and modular templates for rapid variant creation.

 - Workflow Innovation: Continuously test and evaluate new AI tools, plugins, and generative workflows to reduce turnaround times and lower production overhead.

Job benefits

 - The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work.

 - A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities.

 - Flexible working options – including remote working.

 - Personal learning budget and development plans.

 - A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace.

 - Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits

title: Senior Product Designer
description: 500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating. Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Portfolio demonstrating expertise in systemic design, advanced prototyping skills, micro-interactions, and the ability to architect solutions with measurable product impact. Experience using motion and animation tools (e.g., Lottie, Rive, After Effects). Strong communication and presentation skills; ability to distill complex ideas into clear narratives and influence stakeholders. Proactively tackle complex and ambiguous challenges, defining requirements and prioritising the most impactful workstreams to deliver clear, compelling, user-centred experiences. Design features, e2e flows, and experiments that align with user needs and business goals (e.g., engagement, retention, etc.). Produce high-fidelity prototypes and mock-ups using Figma or advanced tools, strategically utilising AI to streamline the concept-to-validation process. Develop and evolve interaction models, motion principles, and visual systems that scale across teams and inspire adoption. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and content designers to deliver cohesive solutions. Proactively mentor peers, junior designers, and non-designers, providing actionable feedback and upskilling guidance to raise the overall craft bar. Advocate for emotionally intelligent, ethical design and ensure accessibility standards are upheld at every stage. Be a key contributor to our design system, ensuring accessibility, inclusivity, and scalability in all outputs. Integrate AI tools into day-to-day work. What you'll be measured on: Deliver complex design initiatives that significantly improve user engagement, retention, and user satisfaction outcomes. Strengthen Flo’s design systems, frameworks, animation and motion principles to enable scalable, high-quality design across teams. Raise team capability and craft standards by mentoring peers and contributing to a culture of design excellence. #LI-AJ1 #LI-Hybrid Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience) £85,000 — £105,000 GBP How we work We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar. You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it.  What you'll get We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like: Competitive salary and annual reviews Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks Diversity, equity and inclusion Our strength is in our differences.
